description: The example decks in examples/decks/: the family each belongs to (`family`, the label front ends group by; `family_key`, the AuthorYear key the CLI and the example scripts use), whether front ends hide it from their example lists, and a one-line summary. Titles and descriptions are read from the decks. Every deck must be listed (ExampleDeckManifest checks).
